cohort: The study included 45 insulin-treated diabetic pregnant women and 90 healthy pregnant women.
finding: A significant increase in macrosomia was observed in diabetic mothers with non-reactive Nonstress Tests (NST).
mod_finding: Fetal size complications in diabetic pregnancies lead to difficulties in delivery and an increased incidence of cesarean section.
cross-section timing: Nonstress test (NST) results were evaluated during pregnancy, and pregnancy outcomes were evaluated at birth.
birth_weight: Macrosomia was evaluated as an outcome.
